body:
I've done acid, shrooms, coke and molly but when my friend asked me if I wanted to go on a beach trip to an island a little out of town and drop 'fake acid' I was a little hesitant. I've been told 25I-NBOMe can actually decrease the effectiveness of other hallucinogens so I was kinda iffy on trying it. At first anyway.
After going with him to buy it, I had 5 tabs to myself at 5 bucks a hit. I took one, then the other, and the rest. Live fast die young leave a good looking corpse. We then went to pick up his girlfriend not telling her what we had just done, to this day he still hasnt told her, although she knows he grows shrooms now. He was driving and took 3 tabs.
[Erowid Note: 
Driving while intoxicated, tripping, or extremely sleep deprived is dangerous and irresponsible because it endangers other people.
Don't do it!
]
As we drove  to the beach listening to music, after awhile of nothing we crossed a bridge onto a beautiful island. At this point I am tripping. The world is spinning and colors are shimmery and beautiful. We stopped for a walk through a forest and I distinctly remember watching the ground breathe. It was a crazy sight. We had to cut the forest journey short because my friends girlfriend saw a snake on the path we were on and ran back to his car. When we finally made it to the beach I noticed that my legs hurt and my neck seemed stiff. The beach was dismal. Guidos bumping music, fat people tanning etc. Yet still I was having an incredibly fun trip. I remember standing still, smoking a cigarette next to an incredibly drunk man singing blurred lines, and wondering how we will rock you became such a big hit. Over all I didnt learn anything about myself like the time I did shrooms and saw what I would look like in the future, but thats the nature of hallucinogens. You dont always go on some crazy life changing journey, but its always fun.
